default.description: ComfyUI master, core nodes only, the model's official workflow with full-precision weights.
default.notes: Official image_ideogram4_t2i template without its LLM prompt-rewrite stage (the other rows take the case prompt as is). fp8 DiTs are the model's release precision, as in the sglang row (ideogram-ai/ideogram-4-fp8); the text encoder is bf16 in place of fp8_scaled. Conditional + unconditional models through DualModelGuider, cfg 7 with the template's CFGOverride, i.e. two forwards on every step like sglang's V4_DEFAULT_20 preset. One GPU: the guidance branches run on two different models, which the CFG Split node does not cover. Weights are the full-precision single-file checkpoints ComfyUI loads (Comfy-Org repackaging or the model's own single-file release); the official template's fp8/int8/nvfp4 defaults are swapped out because they are a different numeric class from every other row. Sampler, scheduler and shift follow the official ComfyUI workflow; steps, CFG, size, frames and seed follow the case. Compile on: the core TorchCompileModel node (inductor) goes behind every diffusion-model loader, as the other competitors run compile-on; measured on FLUX.1 / 1xB200 2026-09-25 at 4.89s against 5.94s and 5.77s eager.

blackwell-gpuonly.description: Blackwell: the default graph with every model resident on the GPU (--gpu-only).
blackwell-gpuonly.notes: B200: --gpu-only keeps every model, text encoders included, stored and run on the card; a 183 GB B200 holds the largest graph here (MiniMax-H3: 62 GB DiT + 48 GB Qwen3-VL-32B + VAEs). Placement only, numerics unchanged. Measured 2026-09-25 on 1xB200, FLUX.1 eager, interleaved arms: default 5.94 / 5.77 / 5.79s against --gpu-only 5.56s and --gpu-only --disable-dynamic-vram 5.57s (Qwen-Image-2.1: 3.75 / 3.91 against 3.47 / 3.48) -- every --gpu-only arm below every default arm; disabling dynamic VRAM on top adds nothing, so the simpler flag is kept.
